In the diagram, $Z$ lies on the segment $GN$. The given vectors are $\overrightarrow{OG}=h$ and $\overrightarrow{ON}=d$. The lengths satisfy $GZ:ZN=5:7$.

Express $\overrightarrow{OZ}$ in terms of $h$ and $d$.
question.:question/worked-solution:
First express both endpoint vectors in the directions away from $O$:

$$
\overrightarrow{OG}=h\qquad \overrightarrow{ON}=d .
$$

Trace the path from $G$ through $O$ to $N$:

$$
\overrightarrow{GN}=\overrightarrow{GO}+\overrightarrow{ON}=-h+d.
$$

The ratio $GZ:ZN=5:7$ gives $12$ parts in the whole segment. Thus

$$
\overrightarrow{GZ}=\frac{5}{12}\overrightarrow{GN}=\frac{5}{12}(-h+d).
$$

Add along the path $O\to G\to Z$ and collect coefficients:

$$
\begin{aligned}\overrightarrow{OZ}&=\overrightarrow{OG}+\overrightarrow{GZ}\\&=h+\frac{5}{12}(-h+d)\\&=\frac{7}{12}h+\frac{5}{12}d.\end{aligned}
$$
